title: Domain x ≥ 1 and range h ≥ 3
caption: The curve starts at (1, 3) and has no points to the left of x = 1 (the root needs x − 1 ≥ 0). It rises from 3 upwards: the range is h(x) ≥ 3.
alt: The graph of h(x) = 3 plus the square root of x minus 1, starting at the point (1, 3) and rising to the right.
description: The root needs x − 1 ≥ 0, so the curve exists only for x ≥ 1.
The first point is (1, 3), the lowest point of the graph.
The curve rises without limit, so the range is every value from 3 upwards.
